description:
Powered by dual 30Ah batteries for a massive 60Ah capacity, this 52V dual-motor cargo e-bike is built for every ride, every road, and every lifestyle. Switch freely between Class 1, 2, 3, or Unlock Mode to match your riding needs with ease.

Featuring one-touch front-wheel drive, rear-wheel drive, and dual-motor drive modes, it adapts instantly whether you're hauling cargo, carrying family, commuting through the city, or exploring longer routes.

More power. More range. More flexibility.Designed to solve range anxiety and adapt to multiple riding scenarios, this is the next generation of cargo e-bikes — built for work, family, and freedom.

From kids to cargo, passengers to heavy loads, this dual-motor cargo e-bike adapts instantly to every situation.

Whether you're carrying your family, transporting goods, or handling daily errands, it delivers smooth power, stability, and confidence in every ride.

Designed for real-world versatility, it’s not just an e-bike — it’s your all-in-one mobility solution for work, life, and adventure.

One Bike. All Scenarios. No Limits.

Dual motor system with selectable rear-wheel drive, front-wheel drive, or dual drive modes, combined with torque and cadence sensor assist for a responsive and smooth riding experience. Features a peak 6400W output for powerful performance and versatile riding. Factory set to Class 2 (20 mph), with support for Class 1, 2, 3, and unlocked modes.

Choose between torque or cadence sensing, allowing the motor to respond either to your pedaling force for a more natural and efficient ride, or to your pedaling rhythm for smooth and consistent power assistance.

Half-twist throttle delivers smooth, precise acceleration, while the quick switch button lets you easily change drive modes: – (front drive), O (dual motor), = (rear drive). Enjoy better control for starts, hill climbs, and different riding conditions with instant, convenient switching.

Like two bikes in one, the Sensor Switch lets you choose between Torque or Cadence sensors, while the easy-to-read color display shows speed, battery level, and riding modes, giving you full control and a customized ride.

Available with a large 52V 60Ah dual-battery system (30Ah + 30Ah combined), providing approximately 100–200 miles per charge in PAS 1 (Class 2), depending on riding conditions. The high-capacity setup is designed for heavy-duty use such as cargo transport, hauling loads, and carrying children, while the removable batteries make charging convenient.

Single-crown front suspension fork with lockout and 80mm travel, designed to absorb shocks and vibrations from rough terrain. It improves riding comfort, stability, and control, and can be locked out for more efficient riding on smooth roads.

Enjoy precise and powerful braking with advanced hydraulic disc brakes. Designed for smooth, reliable stopping power, they provide control and safety in all conditions, ensuring confidence on every ride.

Made with extra-wide 11in design and high-resilience padding, it provides maximum comfort and effectively absorbs shocks from rough terrain, making it perfect for long-distance rides.

Equipped with a rear light featuring left/right turn signals and a brake light, enhancing your visibility and safety on the road.
